notes:
PASS on the fake backend only (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level or a hardware run). The package is model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null); no human review or test and no hardware run is claimed. WHAT IT SERVES: the card's models[0], robot/g1_29dof/g1_29dof.xml, as a MujocoDriver in simulated mode R0. cap.world.step.v1 takes {ticks, action: {ctrl: [...]}}; the bridge checks each of the 29 ctrl elements against the model's actuator_ctrlrange before writing data.ctrl, then runs mj_step ticks times. cap.world.reset.v1 restores the model defaults with mj_resetData + mj_forward. The state is the bridge's integration state (time_ms, qpos, qvel, ctrl, tick, timestep_ms, seed) and native_checkpoint. The driver declares no Limit: the bridge derives action.ctrl per element from the MJCF ctrlrange (hip pitch/yaw and waist yaw +-88, hip roll and knee +-139, ankle and waist roll/pitch +-50, shoulder and elbow +-25, wrist pitch/yaw +-5). Every actuator has a range, so no control is operator_required and there is no site-limits.example.json. WHY THIS SHAPE: the card is family-config with helper MujocoDriver and candidate classes cap.world.reset.v1/cap.world.step.v1. The card's entry symbol eval.wbt_rollout:G1Sim was confirmed at eval/wbt_rollout.py:199; it wraps this model and its step calls mujoco.mj_step (eval/wbt_rollout.py:415-416). The family serves the model's raw torque channels; G1Sim's PD controller, its q_target interface and its observation builder are not part of this driver. The clone is read only and is never copied into the package or imported. MODEL SCENE: the raw XML names a floor geom it does not define and uses a relative meshdir; the driver applies the same text patch as the upstream _load_deploy_model (drop the contact pair block, inject the floor plane, absolute meshdir, eval/wbt_rollout.py:159-178) at load time and writes the upstream SIM_DT of 0.0005 s (eval/wbt_rollout.py:39, :206), so the published timestep_ms is 0.5. The raw model is not directly loadable; the patched scene was not compiled by the real engine here. NOT COVERED: MuJoCo was not importable where the gate ran (no network, no pip), so backends['fake'] is this package's stand-in mujoco module (fake.py). It parses the patched XML for the qpos/qvel dimensions, the 29 control ranges and the option timestep, but integrates a placeholder first-order motion of each actuated joint toward its control value; it loads no mesh, texture, inertia, contact, friction, tendon, equality or actuator constraint, does not integrate the free base and uses the bridge's basic snapshot profile because it has no mj_getState/mj_setState. No trajectory was compared with MuJoCo. The real sim backend is the unlisted backend name: MujocoDriver.open_native returns None and the bridge imports the official mujoco module and loads the same patched XML; that path was not run here and needs mujoco (requirements.txt: numpy, mujoco, torch). No hardware backend exists; DEPLOYMENT.md:7-10 says the Holosoma runtime and the Unitree SDK are not bundled, so no physical Unitree G1 is controlled and no hardware run is claimed. WARNINGS (none failed): G6.NOT_RECORDED and G7.UPSTREAM_BACKEND because the fake is a callable stand-in for the mujoco module, not a package class the gate can record; G8.NO_UNIT x3 for ticks, action.ctrl[*] and seed, simulator-family inputs with no unit. No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warning was raised. TESTS: test_driver.py keeps mhs.testing.check_driver and adds six cases (model dimensions and 0.5 ms timestep, per-actuator ctrlrange refusals with no tick change, state following the control, reset to the model defaults, published fidelity contract, e-stop latch); they pass. No catalogue_requests: only cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.reset.v1 are used.

MODEL REVIEW (gpt-6.1-sol, a model and not a human, 2026-11-17; reviewed_by stays null): Model review checked the pinned G1 entry, every fact and motor range, the scene patch, stop/reset semantics, fake behavior and model-specific BSD-3-Clause notice. Corrected driver.py and facts.md for hip-roll ctrlrange +/-88 (distinct from the joint actuatorfrcrange +/-139), wrist-roll coverage, sensor kinds and citation scope, and published the stand-in as F0 through fidelity_by_backend. Updated fake.py to interpret motor controls as efforts with explicit placeholder inverse inertia, and test_driver.py to check effort response, fidelity and latch-only reset; the effort/fidelity regressions failed before the fix. Regenerated reference.json, REFERENCE.md and check-report.json; the final fake gate and strict collector pass with contract_checked evidence only. For the human reviewer: Only the fake backend was run; the patched MJCF was not compiled by the real engine. The stand-in reads the model dimensions and all 29 ctrlranges but has placeholder inertia, no free-base dynamics or contacts, and no physical trajectory validity. The lockstep stop retains qpos, qvel and ctrl; safety reset only releases the latch, while a later explicit world step may reuse ctrl. The repository is Apache-2.0, but robot/g1_29dof/LICENSE and NOTICE retain BSD-3-Clause Unitree model/mesh attribution and describe Apache-2.0 Holosoma modifications. No upstream code or assets were copied, imported or run. The Holosoma/Unitree hardware runtime remains outside this package.
